How Automation works · safety

Prepare a batch and check protected profiles. Instagram opens in its own Chrome session; sign in there. Relationship-changing actions need approval and verified outcomes. Keep your PC on. Instagram restrictions can interrupt a job. Uncertain clicks are never replayed automatically.

Both options preserve the original results and possible-click journals. Planning does not change relationships or mark anyone Reviewed.
Alternative uses read-only, same-origin list pages from your authenticated Instagram Chrome session. Full pagination is required; unavailable, restricted or incomplete lists never count as non-followback. Does not change Profile Counts or open ten target tabs.
Sequential mode finishes checking one profile before opening the next. Ten-tab mode prepares all 10 first and returns to the first; both keep the same safety and verification checks.

Instagram login/verification requires manual attention.

The robot cannot confirm a logged-in account. If regular Chrome works but this separate Chrome asks for CAPTCHA repeatedly, pause the robot and use your imported lists. Never copy cookies or delete session folders to fix it.

Manual CSV import/export remains available even when the Windows robot is connected or Instagram rejects its Chrome session. Historical counts are not proof of live followback. Do not mark a pending request canceled unless Instagram confirms it. Recovery instructions.

Chrome Companion · Your regular Chrome session

If Instagram works in normal Chrome but blocks the separate robot Chrome, use the optional read-only extension included in the extracted official Windows ZIP, inside chrome-extension. It reads visible counters only when you click Capture; it does not cancel requests or unfollow.

Extension setup guide

② In Chrome: chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked → select chrome-extension from the extracted ZIP. ③ Open an Instagram profile, capture visible Followers/Following and export the latest or the complete dated history. Importing older measurements will not overwrite newer results. This uses your signed-in normal Chrome and requires no password or cookie sharing. It is a manually operated Profile Counts path, not a background bot.

◎ Profile Counts · Collected Results

All imported profiles are included in the calculations, regardless of account size. Each successful measurement is retained by date for oldest-first re-audits and comparison; latest values remain in the table. Historical counts are not evidence of current followback.

Instagram Cleaner Pro — Privacy

LOCAL-FIRST Original Instagram ZIP/JSON/HTML exports are processed locally and are not uploaded as cloud backups. IF YOU ENABLE SYNC Derived data needed for Desktop–Android synchronization may be stored privately in your account: usernames and relationship lists, review/protection/snooze states, Focus batches, audit events and device metadata. LOCAL STORAGE The app uses localStorage and IndexedDB to keep your state, reviews and snapshots. This data remains until you remove or reset it, or a documented migration changes it. BACKUPS / CHANGES Export a backup from Vault before a reset or destructive migration. Changing browser origin, path or profile may use a separate storage context. SYNCED DATA MANAGEMENT You can export all of your account's currently synchronized cloud data to JSON or delete its synchronized records. Cloud deletion does not remove your original ZIP/JSON/HTML or independent local backups. After cloud deletion, the app signs out to prevent auto-sync from immediately re-uploading local state.
Sign in under Account to export or delete synced data.
